title: Greaves Electric FY28 Target Se Pehle Break-Even Ke Liye Tayyar, Naya EV Scooter Hoga Launch
summary: Greaves Electric Mobility ne FY28 target se pehle break-even ka daawa kiya hai. Company jald hi 'Icebreaker' codename wala naya Magnus electric scooter launch karne ja rahi hai.
key_points: Greaves Electric FY28 ke original target se pehle hi break-even achieve karne ki tayyari me hai.
Agle teen mahino me 'Icebreaker' codename wala naya Magnus EV scooter launch hoga.
October me company ki monthly sales badh kar 16,000-17,000 units tak pahunch gayi.
Ranipet plant ki capacity badhane aur aage ki growth ke liye nayi funding par vichar chal raha hai.
body: Greaves Electric Mobility ne jald hi profitability hasil karne ka daawa kiya hai, jo ki unke FY28 ke shuruaati break-even target se pehle hai. Company ke Managing Director Vikas Singh ke mutabiq, sales volume me badhotri aur behtar market share ke dam par company agle saal Q4 ke target ko aasani se peeche chhod degi.

Is growth ko raftaar dene ke liye Greaves agle teen mahino me apna naya electric scooter launch karne ki tayyari me hai, jise codename 'Icebreaker' diya gaya hai. Yeh next-generation Magnus scooter petrol se chalne wale conventional scooters ke buyers ko EV ki taraf aakarshit karne ke maqsad se design kiya gaya hai. Current Magnus GMax filhaal company ki total sales ka lagbhag 50 per cent hissa hai.

Company ki monthly sales pichle saal ke 8,000-9,000 units se badh kar October me 16,000-17,000 units tak pahunch gayi hai. EV two-wheeler market me Greaves ka market share lagbhag 6 per cent hai aur company ab paanchve sthan par pahunch gayi hai. Iske alawa, haal hi me 530 crore rupe jutane ke baad company Ranipet facility ki capacity badhane aur nayi funding par bhi board level par charcha kar rahi hai.
why_it_matters: Electric two-wheeler market me badhti competition ke beech petrol scooter users ko EV par shift hone ke liye naye options milenge. Isse consumers ko affordable aur updated technology wale electric scooters ka vikalp milega.
